text: {"assertions":["A NaN (not-a-number) feature bug was discovered in ml/features/encoder.py that only occurred when two requests raced on the same key.","The root cause of the NaN feature bug was a missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) in the database.","The bug was fixed by adding the composite index and backfilling data in batches via PR #5131 on branch fix/nan-feature-1.","The NaN feature bug could be reproduced by encoding the batch holding the sparse column.","Fixing the NaN feature bug reclaimed 32 GB of blob storage.","The NaN feature work in ml/features/encoder.py built on context from earlier related NaN feature debugging efforts."]}
